privacy.prefix: This site is protected by reCAPTCHA and the Google

controller.heading: Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of your data is Enrique Reaño, with tax ID 48295278Q and address at Calle Bailarín José Espadero, 8, 03015 Alicante.
You can contact the controller, and exercise your rights, by writing to kiketon@gmail.com.

data.heading: Data we process
paragraphs: When you register a school we process the school name and its municipality, and your first name, last name and email. We use them to create your administrator account and provide the service.
When you sign in we process your email and your password. The password is only compared with the hash we store and is not kept.
Your password is not stored: we only keep a hash, which cannot be used to recover it.
We also store the date on which you accepted this policy and the version you accepted.

ip.heading: IP address
paragraphs: To limit failed sign-up and sign-in attempts and protect the service against abuse, we store the IP address from which an account registration or a sign-in is attempted. Successful sign-ins leave no attempt stored.
Every day we delete the attempts that are more than 24 hours old, so we keep the IP for at most about 48 hours in the database and up to 30 days in backups.
Activity logs also contain the IP address and the browser (user agent) of the requests, together with your masked email, and are kept for 30 days.

cookie.heading: Session cookie
paragraphs: We use a single first-party technical cookie called refresh_token. It keeps you signed in and lasts 24 hours.
We do not use advertising or analytics cookies. Google reCAPTCHA may set its own when you submit the sign-up or sign-in form (see the reCAPTCHA section).

recaptcha.heading: Google reCAPTCHA
paragraphs: To tell people from bots, the sign-up and sign-in forms use Google reCAPTCHA. The Google script is only loaded when you submit the sign-up or sign-in form, not before and not on other pages.

Google receives data from your browser and device, such as your IP address, and may set cookies. That data may be transferred to the United States under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, and is governed by Google's privacy policy and terms.

providers.heading: Providers that process your data
paragraphs: Supabase hosts the database in Frankfurt, in the European Union. Amazon Web Services (AWS) hosts the application, backups and activity logs, also in the European Union.
Google processes the reCAPTCHA data, as explained in the previous section.

retention.heading: Retention periods
paragraphs: Your account data is kept for as long as you keep the account.
Backups are kept for 30 days. Activity logs are also kept for 30 days and contain the IP and the browser (user agent) of the requests.
The IP address of the attempts is deleted every day once it is more than 24 hours old, so it is kept for at most about 48 hours in the database and up to 30 days in backups.

legalBasis.heading: Legal basis
paragraphs: We process your account data to perform the service contract (art. 6.1.b GDPR).
We process the IP address and use reCAPTCHA for our legitimate interest in the security of the service (art. 6.1.f GDPR).
The checkbox you tick when signing up confirms that you have read this policy; it is not the consent on which the processing is based.

rights.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability by writing to the controller's contact email.
If you believe we have not respected your rights, you can lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (Agencia Española de Protección de Datos, www.aepd.es).

preferred.intro: Mark the slots in which it is better for this subject to go; the timetable will prefer them when it can. Forbidden slots and breaks cannot be marked.
preferred.noCalendarHint: Assign it a calendar from Calendars to define the slots in which it is better for the subject to go.

readiness.title: Generate timetables
readiness.intro: Checks whether the school is ready to generate the timetables and what has to be fixed first. Each problem has a link to where it is fixed.
readiness.loadError: The check could not be done.

verdict.notReady_one: Not ready to generate yet: {{count}} problem
verdict.notReady_other: Not ready to generate yet: {{count}} problems

readiness.note: No problems does not guarantee that a timetable exists: the generation checks it.

issues.SCHOOL_WITHOUT_COURSES: The school has no courses yet.
issues.WORKLOAD_EXCEEDS_SLOTS: {{course}}: the load of {{assigned}} sessions exceeds the {{available}} of its calendar.
issues.BLOCK_LARGER_THAN_LOAD: {{subject}} in {{course}}: asks for blocks larger than its weekly sessions.
issues.SUBJECT_DOES_NOT_FIT: {{subject}} in {{course}} does not fit in the week with its rules.
issues.SUBJECT_DOES_NOT_FIT_WITH_PROFESSOR: {{subject}} in {{course}} {{class}} does not fit with {{professor}}: its forbidden slots and the hours they cannot work leave no room.
issues.EXCEEDS_MAX_HOURS: {{professor}} passes 23 h even with the shortest sessions.
issues.AVAILABILITY_INSUFFICIENT_one: {{professor}} has {{count}} session in "{{calendar}}" and can only give {{available}}.
issues.AVAILABILITY_INSUFFICIENT_other: {{professor}} has {{count}} sessions in "{{calendar}}" and can only give {{available}}.
issues.SUBJECT_INACTIVE: {{subject}} is inactive and will not be generated ({{courses}}).
issues.WORKLOAD_BELOW_SLOTS_one: {{course}} has {{assigned}} sessions for {{available}} slots: {{count}} slot will stay free in each class.
issues.WORKLOAD_BELOW_SLOTS_other: {{course}} has {{assigned}} sessions for {{available}} slots: {{count}} slots will stay free in each class.
issues.MAY_EXCEED_MAX_HOURS: {{professor}} may pass 23 h depending on the sessions they get.
issues.SEVERAL_CALENDARS_other: {{professor}} teaches in {{count}} calendars: the generation checks that their sessions do not overlap.
issues.SLOTS_OUTSIDE_CALENDAR_one: {{subject}} in {{course}}: {{count}} saved slot no longer exists in the calendar and is ignored.
issues.SLOTS_OUTSIDE_CALENDAR_other: {{subject}} in {{course}}: {{count}} saved slots no longer exist in the calendar and are ignored.
issues.PREFERRED_SLOTS_FORBIDDEN_one: {{subject}} in {{course}}: {{count}} preferred slot is also forbidden and is ignored.
issues.PREFERRED_SLOTS_FORBIDDEN_other: {{subject}} in {{course}}: {{count}} preferred slots are also forbidden and are ignored.

generation.title: Timetable generation
generation.loading: Checking whether there is a generation…
generation.loadError: The generation could not be loaded.
generation.queued: Queued: waiting for the generation to start…
generation.progressStale: The progress could not be updated. It will be tried again.
generation.completedNote: Review it before confirming it as the official one. If you generate again, the draft is replaced.
generation.blocked: Fix the problems that prevent generating first.
generation.adminsOnly: Only administrators can generate the timetables.

errors.start: The generation could not be started. Try again.
errors.forbidden: Only administrators can generate the timetables.
errors.notReady: The school has problems that prevent generating. The check has been repeated.
errors.cancel: The generation could not be cancelled. Try again.

failed.NOT_READY: The school is no longer ready to generate. The check has been repeated.
failed.INFEASIBLE: No timetable that meets all the rules was found.
failed.TIMEOUT: The search ran out of time without finding a timetable. Try relaxing the rules: remove forbidden slots, reduce the blocks or the daily maximum, or spread the professors' load better.
failed.INTERNAL: Internal error during the generation. Try again or contact support (ID: {{id}}).

reasons.NO_FREE_CELLS: The workload does not fit in the free cells of the calendars.
reasons.CLASS_BUSY: The class ran out of free slots to place a session.
reasons.PROFESSOR_BUSY: The professor ran out of free slots to place a session.
reasons.DAILY_RULE: The distribution rules (daily maximum, blocks or forbidden slots) prevented placing a session.
reasons.MAX_HOURS: The professor's maximum teaching hours prevented placing a session.

failed.reasonNote: This is only a hint: the restriction that ruled out the most options, not necessarily the only cause.

generation.isOfficial: This timetable is the official one

improve.label: Improve the schedule with the preferences
improve.help: Takes longer, up to one more minute, and reduces the gaps of the professors and respects the preferred slots.

stopDialog.title: Stop the improvement?
stopDialog.message: The valid schedule found so far will be saved, with the preferences that could be applied. It cannot be resumed: to keep improving you will have to generate again.

generation.notImproved: Generated without improving: the preferences were not applied
generation.improvementStopped: The improvement was stopped: the valid schedule has been saved

draft.empty: No timetable has been generated yet.
draft.noProfessors: No professor has sessions in this timetable.
